column1: # Privileged tests EXPECTED TO FAIL on one lab guest (lab PR 227).
# Each line is a failure the lab has recorded as a follow-up: the test fails
# the same on `main`, the fix is owed, and until it lands the gate must not
# turn red on it nor lose sight of it. `cargo xtask gate-summary` (the CI
# job summary, its gate-summary.json, `cargo xtask gate-report`) lists every
# line that applies to the guest with its outcome, next to the totals: an
# expected failure is never folded into "passed" nor dropped. The run fails
# when such a test passes (the follow-up is fixed: remove its line) or does
# not run (renamed, skipped, its suite crashed), and on any failure not
# listed here. A line applies to its distro only (NN_LAB_DISTRO).
# Columns, tab-separated: distro, suite (the test target, as cargo's
# "Running" line names it), test (as libtest prints it), the follow-up.
# xtask/tests/lab_ci.rs checks that every distro is a guest of nn-lab.sh and
# every test exists in its suite.
# None today. The one line the gate started with — Debian 13's DNS
# attribution under nss-resolve (lab PR 164) — was removed when lab PR 229
# fixed it (the uprobe on systemd-resolved's NSS module).
